Transactions exhibited layering patterns and rapid velocity inconsistent with declared import/export business. Email address v.petrov.trading@protonmail.com is flagged in FinCEN 314(b) and ACAMS shared intelligence for suspected trade-based money laundering. Prior SAR (SAR-2026-00147) filed for structuring. Accounts frozen and wire recalls initiated for two pending transactions. Graph analysis confirms fan-out pattern to high-risk jurisdictions and round-tripping of funds. Enhanced due diligence previously conducted; adverse media present. Fraud confirmed via internal investigation.
